question: Please provide a list of the top three revenue-generating films for each actor, along with the average revenue per actor in those films, calculated by dividing the total film revenue equally among the actors for each film.

prediction.sql:
WITH film_rev AS (
  SELECT i.film_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_rev
  FROM payment p
  JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  GROUP BY i.film_id
),
film_actor_cnt AS (
  SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS actor_cnt
  FROM film_actor
  GROUP BY film_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    a.actor_id,
    a.first_name,
    a.last_name,
    f.title,
    fr.total_rev,
    fr.total_rev / fac.actor_cnt AS avg_rev_per_actor,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.actor_id ORDER BY fr.total_rev DESC) AS rn
  FROM film_actor fa
  JOIN actor a ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id
  JOIN film f ON fa.film_id = f.film_id
  JOIN film_rev fr ON f.film_id = fr.film_id
  JOIN film_actor_cnt fac ON f.film_id = fac.film_id
)
SELECT actor_id, first_name, last_name, title, total_rev, avg_rev_per_actor
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY actor_id, rn;

persistent_recovery_advisory_draft.base_sql:
WITH film_revenue AS (
  SELECT i.film_id, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue
  FROM payment p
  JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  GROUP BY i.film_id
),
film_actor_count AS (
  SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS actor_count
  FROM film_actor
  GROUP BY film_id
),
actor_film_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    a.actor_id,
    a.first_name,
    a.last_name,
    f.film_id,
    f.title,
    fr.revenue,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.actor_id ORDER BY fr.revenue DESC) AS rn
  FROM actor a
  JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id
  JOIN film f ON fa.film_id = f.film_id
  JOIN film_revenue fr ON f.film_id = fr.film_id
)
SELECT
  a.actor_id,
  a.first_name,
  a.last_name,
  a.title,
  a.revenue,
  a.revenue / fac.actor_count AS avg_revenue_per_actor
FROM actor_film_ranked a
JOIN film_actor_count fac ON a.film_id = fac.film_id
WHERE a.rn <= 3
ORDER BY a.actor_id, a.rn;
